title: Polka and mazurka
summary: Allen asks about polka, mazurka and other dances; Mrs. Clementin says she danced many.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Yeah, it's picking up. Well, we could talk about some more dances. Pokers, Missourkas, quadrilles, shortages. What else did you do? Did you do polka? No polka?
Yeah, but that's why I always sit with Zuka.
You dance a lot of polka?
Oh, yeah. You didn't dance all of them dances, but I danced different frames. Oh, I see.
You didn't like the dance as much as her? She's wearing her, huh?

Well, you know, she used to like it's beer, you see. Beer? And me, I never drink. Yeah. Yeah, you understand, you come up to it, you get beer. I guess they give it somewhere, you go on the beach, you see. And you see how it's going to come down and you all go out here. I don't know.
